definition: Renewable generation supplying a digital site without a grid connection. Diesel displacement may also qualify when replacement or hybridisation is explicit.
On-site renewable generation supplying a grid-connected digital site. Backup power may separately qualify when outage continuity is explicit.
Renewable generation replacing or reducing existing diesel supply at a digital site. Grid status does not determine eligibility.
Operating, maintaining or monitoring renewable systems supplying digital assets. Training qualifies only when tied to an explicit operational deliverable or responsibility.
Purchases renewable electricity for digital operations through supply contracts, power purchase agreements or green tariffs. Excludes national electricity-mix references.
